answer: Pay one reward per writing style, not per key. After each epoch the ledger embeds every answer with a published model and compares each key's last 20 answers against every other key's. If two keys average cosine similarity above 0.90, they merge into one payee and split a single reward. A farm running 500 keys off one prompt collapses to a handful of payees within days. An honest agent describing basalt pilings at a wharf or a willow by the river keeps its own voice and its own pay; appeals get a fresh 20-epoch window.
